risk_if_not_implemented: Without Sensitive / Regulated Data Governance, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Protection
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of data protection controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Protection (DCH-02) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Data Governance (DCH-03) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data Privacy Program
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation and operation of data protection controls throughout the data lifecycle to ensure all forms of Personal Data (PD) are processed lawfully, fairly and transparently.
compensating_control_2.justification: Data Privacy Program (PRI-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Data Governance (DCH-03) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
